tabs.title: Work Experience
content: My journey in web development has seen me tackle a variety of projects using React, WordPress, and SASS.I've built custom WordPress themes with PHP, while ensuring top-notch SEO and security standards.I led the Call Me Guide project, spearheading development with React on the frontend and Laravel for backend and PHP for server-side.
Before diving into web development, I spent 10 years as a journalist, authored a travel book, and guided adventure tours across Africa.
